question.text: How can Clearing Members know about Auto DOs (delivery-out instructions) for pay-out?

answer.text: Downloads from the Clearing Corporation, Auto DO report from the DP, or depository internet facilities
Only through a phone call to the CC
Only through the stock exchange website
Only through physical statements mailed by the DP

explanation.text: The Logic: Clearing Members can know about Auto DOs through downloads from the Clearing Corporation, the Auto DO report from their DP, or the depository internet facilities. The Trap: 'Only phone call' ignores the electronic and internet-based channels listed in the source. Note: The three channels — CC downloads, DP reports, and depository internet facilities — give CMs multiple ways to verify Auto DOs.
